  WHERE sales.DateKey >= DATE '2009-01-01'
    AND sales.DateKey < DATE '2010-01-01'
  GROUP BY store.StoreKey, DATE_TRUNC('month', sales.DateKey)
),
month_list AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT DATE_TRUNC('month', calendar.DateKey) AS month
  FROM calendar
  WHERE calendar.DateKey >= DATE '2009-01-01'
    AND calendar.DateKey < DATE '2010-01-01'
),
store_months AS (
  SELECT t.StoreKey,
         t.StoreName,
         m.month,
         t.annual_target / 12.0 AS monthly_target,
         COALESCE(s.actual, 0) AS actual
  FROM annual_target t
  CROSS JOIN month_list m
  LEFT JOIN monthly_sales s
    ON s.StoreKey = t.StoreKey
   AND s.month = m.month
),
below_flags AS (
  SELECT StoreKey,
         StoreName,
         month,
         CASE WHEN actual < monthly_target THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS below
  FROM store_months
),
below_months AS (
  SELECT StoreKey,
         StoreName,
         month,
         EXTRACT(MONTH FROM month)::int
           - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY StoreKey ORDER BY month)::int AS grp
  FROM below_flags
  WHERE below = 1
),
runs AS (
  SELECT StoreKey,
         StoreName,
         MIN(month) AS start_month,
         MAX(month) AS end_month,
         COUNT(*) AS consecutive_months
  FROM below_months
  GROUP BY StoreKey, StoreName, grp
)
SELECT CAST(StoreKey AS INTEGER) AS store_key,
       StoreName AS store_name,
       TO_CHAR(start_month, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS start_month,
       TO_CHAR(end_month, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS end_month,
       consecutive_months
FROM runs
WHERE consecutive_months >= 3
ORDER BY StoreKey, start_month

  JOIN target_annual ta ON tm.store_key = ta.store_key
),
actual_monthly AS (

store_compare AS (

    StoreKey,

    SUM(CASE WHEN year_start = DATE '2008-01-01' THEN sales_amount ELSE 0 END) AS sales_2008,

    SUM(CASE WHEN year_start = DATE '2008-01-01' THEN sales_amount ELSE 0 END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN year_start = DATE '2009-01-01' THEN sales_amount ELSE 0 END) AS decrease_amount,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN year_start = DATE '2008-01-01' THEN sales_amount ELSE 0 END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN year_start = DATE '2009-01-01' THEN sales_amount ELSE 0 END))
      / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN year_start = DATE '2008-01-01' THEN sales_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100 AS decline_pct
  FROM store_year
  GROUP BY StoreKey, StoreName
  HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN year_start = DATE '2008-01-01' THEN sales_amount ELSE 0 END) > 0

),
top3 AS (

),

WITH store_year AS (
  SELECT
    store.StoreKey AS StoreKey,
    store.StoreName AS StoreName,
    DATE_TRUNC('year', sales.DateKey) AS year_start,
    MEASURE(sales.sales_amount) AS sales_amount
  FROM sales CROSS JOIN store
  WHERE sales.DateKey >= DATE '2008-01-01' AND sales.DateKey < DATE '2010-01-01'
  GROUP BY store.StoreKey, store.StoreName, DATE_TRUNC('year', sales.DateKey)
),
store_compare AS (
  SELECT
    StoreKey,
    StoreName,
    SUM(CASE WHEN year_start = DATE '2008-01-01' THEN sales_amount ELSE 0 END) AS sales_2008,
    SUM(CASE WHEN year_start = DATE '2009-01-01' THEN sales_amount ELSE 0 END) AS sales_2009,
    SUM(CASE WHEN year_start = DATE '2008-01-01' THEN sales_amount ELSE 0 END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN year_start = DATE '2009-01-01' THEN sales_amount ELSE 0 END) AS decrease_amount,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN year_start = DATE '2008-01-01' THEN sales_amount ELSE 0 END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN year_start = DATE '2009-01-01' THEN sales_amount ELSE 0 END))
      / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN year_start = DATE '2008-01-01' THEN sales_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100 AS decline_pct
  FROM store_year
  GROUP BY StoreKey, StoreName
  HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN year_start = DATE '2008-01-01' THEN sales_amount ELSE 0 END) > 0
     AND SUM(CASE WHEN year_start = DATE '2009-01-01' THEN sales_amount ELSE 0 END) > 0
     AND SUM(CASE WHEN year_start = DATE '2008-01-01' THEN sales_amount ELSE 0 END)
       > SUM(CASE WHEN year_start = DATE '2009-01-01' THEN sales_amount ELSE 0 END)
),
top3 AS (
  SELECT
    StoreKey,
    StoreName,
    sales_2008,
    sales_2009,
    decrease_amount,
    decline_pct,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY decline_pct DESC, StoreKey) AS rn
  FROM store_compare
),
category_year AS (
  SELECT
    sales.StoreKey AS StoreKey,
    DATE_TRUNC('year', sales.DateKey) AS year_start,
    COALESCE(product_category.ProductCategoryName, '未知产品') AS category_name,
    MEASURE(sales.sales_amount) AS sales_amount
  FROM product
  CROSS JOIN (product_subcategory CROSS JOIN (sales CROSS JOIN product_category))
  WHERE sales.DateKey >= DATE '2008-01-01' AND sales.DateKey < DATE '2010-01-01'
  GROUP BY sales.StoreKey, DATE_TRUNC('year', sales.DateKey), COALESCE(product_category.ProductCategoryName, '未知产品')
),
category_compare AS (
  SELECT
    StoreKey,
    category_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN year_start = DATE '2008-01-01' THEN sales_amount ELSE 0 END) AS cat_sales_2008,
    SUM(CASE WHEN year_start = DATE '2009-01-01' THEN sales_amount ELSE 0 END) AS cat_sales_2009,
    SUM(CASE WHEN year_start = DATE '2008-01-01' THEN sales_amount ELSE 0 END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN year_start = DATE '2009-01-01' THEN sales_amount ELSE 0 END) AS cat_decrease
  FROM category_year
  GROUP BY StoreKey, category_name
),
category_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    t.StoreKey,
    t.StoreName,
    t.sales_2008,
    t.sales_2009,
    t.decrease_amount AS store_decrease_amount,
    t.decline_pct AS store_decline_pct,
    c.category_name,
    c.cat_sales_2008,
    c.cat_sales_2009,
    c.cat_decrease AS category_decrease_amount,
    c.cat_decrease / NULLIF(t.decrease_amount, 0) * 100 AS category_share_pct,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.StoreKey ORDER BY c.cat_decrease DESC, c.category_name) AS cat_rn
  FROM top3 t
  JOIN category_compare c ON t.StoreKey = c.StoreKey
  WHERE t.rn <= 3
)
SELECT
  StoreName,
  store_decline_pct,
  store_decrease_amount,
  category_name,
  category_decrease_amount,
  category_share_pct
FROM category_ranked
WHERE cat_rn = 1
ORDER BY store_decline_pct DESC

WITH store_year AS (
  SELECT store.StoreKey AS store_key, store.StoreName AS store_name,
         calendar.CalendarYear AS yr,
         MEASURE(sales.sales_amount) AS amt
  FROM store CROSS JOIN sales CROSS JOIN calendar
  WHERE calendar.CalendarYear IN (2008, 2009)
  GROUP BY store.StoreKey, store.StoreName, calendar.CalendarYear
),
store_pivot AS (
  SELECT store_key, store_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2008 THEN amt ELSE 0 END) AS s2008,
    SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2009 THEN amt ELSE 0 END) AS s2009
  FROM store_year
  GROUP BY store_key, store_name
),
top3 AS (
  SELECT CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (s2008 - s2009) / s2008 DESC) AS BIGINT) AS rank_no,
    store_key, store_name, s2008, s2009,
    (s2008 - s2009) AS total_reduction,
    (s2008 - s2009) / s2008 AS decline_pct
  FROM store_pivot
  WHERE s2008 > 0 AND s2009 > 0 AND s2009 < s2008
  ORDER BY decline_pct DESC
  LIMIT 3
),
cat_year AS (
  SELECT sales.StoreKey AS store_key,
         product_category.ProductCategoryName AS category_name,
         calendar.CalendarYear AS yr,
         MEASURE(sales.sales_amount) AS amt
  FROM product_category CROSS JOIN (
         product_subcategory CROSS JOIN (
           product CROSS JOIN (
             sales CROSS JOIN calendar
           )
         )
       )
  WHERE sales.StoreKey IN (SELECT store_key FROM top3)
    AND calendar.CalendarYear IN (2008, 2009)
  GROUP BY sales.StoreKey, product_category.ProductCategoryName, calendar.CalendarYear
),
cat_pivot AS (
  SELECT store_key, COALESCE(category_name, '未知产品') AS category_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2008 THEN amt ELSE 0 END) AS s2008,
    SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2009 THEN amt ELSE 0 END) AS s2009
  FROM cat_year
  GROUP BY store_key, COALESCE(category_name, '未知产品')
),
cat_reduce AS (
  SELECT store_key, category_name,
    (s2008 - s2009) AS reduction,
    CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_key ORDER BY (s2008 - s2009) DESC) AS BIGINT) AS rn
  FROM cat_pivot
)
SELECT
  t.rank_no,
  t.store_name,
  ROUND(t.decline_pct * 100, 2) AS store_decline_pct,
  c.category_name,
  ROUND(c.reduction, 2) AS category_reduction,
  ROUND(c.reduction / t.total_reduction * 100, 2) AS share_of_store_reduction_pct
FROM top3 t
JOIN cat_reduce c ON c.store_key = t.store_key AND c.rn = 1
ORDER BY t.decline_pct DESC

WITH store_year AS (
  SELECT sales.StoreKey AS store_key,
         store.StoreName AS store_name,
         calendar.CalendarYear AS yr,
         MEASURE(sales.sales_amount) AS amt
  FROM store CROSS JOIN sales CROSS JOIN calendar
  WHERE calendar.CalendarYear IN (2008, 2009)
  GROUP BY sales.StoreKey, store.StoreName, calendar.CalendarYear
),
store_pivot AS (
  SELECT store_key, store_name,
         SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2008 THEN amt ELSE 0 END) AS amt_2008,
         SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2009 THEN amt ELSE 0 END) AS amt_2009,
         SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2008 THEN amt ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2009 THEN amt ELSE 0 END) AS decline_amt,
         (SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2008 THEN amt ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2009 THEN amt ELSE 0 END))
           / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2008 THEN amt ELSE 0 END), 0) AS decline_pct
  FROM store_year
  GROUP BY store_key, store_name
  HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2008 THEN amt ELSE 0 END) > 0
     AND SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2009 THEN amt ELSE 0 END) > 0
     AND SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2009 THEN amt ELSE 0 END) < SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2008 THEN amt ELSE 0 END)
),
top3 AS (
  SELECT store_key, store_name, amt_2008, amt_2009, decline_amt, decline_pct
  FROM store_pivot
  ORDER BY decline_pct DESC
  LIMIT 3
),
cat_year AS (
  SELECT sales.StoreKey AS store_key,
         product_category.ProductCategoryName AS category_name,
         DATE_TRUNC('year', sales.DateKey) AS yr,
         MEASURE(sales.sales_amount) AS amt
  FROM product_category CROSS JOIN (product_subcategory CROSS JOIN (sales CROSS JOIN product))
  WHERE sales.DateKey >= DATE '2008-01-01' AND sales.DateKey < DATE '2010-01-01'
  GROUP BY sales.StoreKey, product_category.ProductCategoryName, DATE_TRUNC('year', sales.DateKey)
),
cat_pivot AS (
  SELECT cy.store_key, cy.category_name,
         SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cy.yr) = 2008 THEN cy.amt ELSE 0 END) AS amt_2008,
         SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cy.yr) = 2009 THEN cy.amt ELSE 0 END) AS amt_2009,
         SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cy.yr) = 2008 THEN cy.amt ELSE 0 END)
           - SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cy.yr) = 2009 THEN cy.amt ELSE 0 END) AS decline_amt
  FROM cat_year cy
  JOIN top3 t ON cy.store_key = t.store_key
  GROUP BY cy.store_key, cy.category_name
),
cat_rank AS (
  SELECT store_key, category_name, decline_amt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_key ORDER BY decline_amt DESC) AS rn
  FROM cat_pivot
  WHERE category_name IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT t.store_name,
       ROUND(t.decline_amt, 2) AS store_decline_amount,
       ROUND(t.decline_pct * 100, 2) AS store_decline_pct,
       c.category_name,
       ROUND(c.decline_amt, 2) AS category_decline_amount,
       ROUND(c.decline_amt / NULLIF(t.decline_amt, 0) * 100, 2) AS category_share_pct
FROM top3 t
JOIN cat_rank c ON t.store_key = c.store_key AND c.rn = 1
ORDER BY t.decline_pct DESC;

WITH cust AS (
  SELECT
    online_sales.CustomerKey AS customer_key,
    customer.Occupation AS occupation,
    customer.YearlyIncome::double precision AS income,
    MEASURE(online_sales.sales_amount)::double precision AS spend
  FROM online_sales CROSS JOIN customer
  WHERE online_sales.DateKey >= DATE '2009-01-01'
    AND online_sales.DateKey < DATE '2010-01-01'
  GROUP BY online_sales.CustomerKey, customer.Occupation, customer.YearlyIncome
  HAVING MEASURE(online_sales.sales_quantity) > 0
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    1 AS sort_order,
    '全体' AS scope_label,
    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS occupation,
    COUNT(*)::double precision AS n,
    COUNT(*)::bigint AS customer_count,
    SUM(income) AS sum_x,
    SUM(spend) AS sum_y,
    SUM(income * spend) AS sum_xy,
    SUM(income * income) AS sum_x2,
    SUM(spend * spend) AS sum_y2
  FROM cust
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    2 AS sort_order,
    '职业内' AS scope_label,
    occupation,
    COUNT(*)::double precision AS n,
    COUNT(*)::bigint AS customer_count,
    SUM(income) AS sum_x,
    SUM(spend) AS sum_y,
    SUM(income * spend) AS sum_xy,
    SUM(income * income) AS sum_x2,
    SUM(spend * spend) AS sum_y2
  FROM cust
  GROUP BY occupation
)
SELECT
  scope_label AS "范围",
  occupation AS "职业",
  customer_count AS "客户数",
  ((n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) /
   NULLIF(SQRT((n * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x) * (n * sum_y2 - sum_y * sum_y)), 0)) AS "Pearson相关系数"
FROM agg

WITH op_a AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    online_sales.SalesOrderNumber AS order_no,
    product.ProductKey AS prod_key_a,
    product.ProductName AS prod_name_a
  FROM online_sales CROSS JOIN product
  WHERE online_sales.DateKey >= DATE '2009-01-01'
    AND online_sales.DateKey < DATE '2010-01-01'
    AND online_sales.SalesQuantity > 0
    AND product.BrandName = 'Contoso'
),
op_b AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    online_sales.SalesOrderNumber AS order_no,
    product.ProductKey AS prod_key_b,
    product.ProductName AS prod_name_b
  FROM online_sales CROSS JOIN product
  WHERE online_sales.DateKey >= DATE '2009-01-01'
    AND online_sales.DateKey < DATE '2010-01-01'
    AND online_sales.SalesQuantity > 0
    AND product.BrandName = 'Contoso'
),
prod_orders AS (
  SELECT prod_key_a AS prod_key, COUNT(DISTINCT order_no) AS orders_cnt
  FROM op_a
  GROUP BY prod_key_a
),
total_orders AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT online_sales.SalesOrderNumber) AS total_cnt
  FROM online_sales
  WHERE online_sales.DateKey >= DATE '2009-01-01'
    AND online_sales.DateKey < DATE '2010-01-01'
    AND online_sales.SalesQuantity > 0
),
pairs AS (
  SELECT
    a.prod_key_a AS k1,
    MAX(a.prod_name_a) AS name1,
    b.prod_key_b AS k2,
    MAX(b.prod_name_b) AS name2,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.order_no) AS common_orders
  FROM op_a a
  JOIN op_b b
    ON a.order_no = b.order_no
   AND a.prod_key_a < b.prod_key_b
  GROUP BY a.prod_key_a, b.prod_key_b
)
SELECT
  CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    ORDER BY p.common_orders DESC,
             CAST(p.common_orders AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * t.total_cnt
               / NULLIF(pa.orders_cnt * pb.orders_cnt, 0) DESC
  ) AS BIGINT) AS rank_no,
  p.name1 AS product_a,
  p.k1 AS product_a_key,
  p.name2 AS product_b,
  p.k2 AS product_b_key,
  p.common_orders,
  pa.orders_cnt AS product_a_orders,
  pb.orders_cnt AS product_b_orders,
  t.total_cnt AS total_orders,
  CAST(p.common_orders AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * t.total_cnt
    / NULLIF(pa.orders_cnt * pb.orders_cnt, 0) AS lift
FROM pairs p
JOIN prod_orders pa ON pa.prod_key = p.k1
JOIN prod_orders pb ON pb.prod_key = p.k2
CROSS JOIN total_orders t
ORDER BY p.common_orders DESC, lift DESC
LIMIT 10
turns.assumption: 产品对只统计 2009 年线上销售行（SalesQuantity > 0）里同一订单同时出现的两款 Contoso 品牌产品；共同订单数为含这两款产品的订单数，提升度 = 共同订单占比 ÷（各自订单占比），分母订单总数取 2009 年全部线上订单。

  FROM online_sales

  SELECT 'Q3' UNION ALL

)

       COALESCE(by_q.new_customers, 0) AS new_customers
FROM quarters
LEFT JOIN by_q ON quarters.q_name = by_q.quarter_label
ORDER BY quarters.q_name

  FROM inventory
  WHERE inventory.DateKey >= DATE '2009-01-01' AND inventory.DateKey < DATE '2010-01-01'
  GROUP BY inventory.ProductKey, DATE_TRUNC('day', inventory.DateKey)
),
inv_avg AS (
  SELECT pkey2,
         AVG(snap_value) AS avg_on_hand_value,
         COUNT(*) AS snapshot_days
  FROM inv
  GROUP BY pkey2
)
SELECT s.pkey AS product_key,
       COALESCE(MAX(s.pname), 'ProductKey ' || CAST(CAST(MAX(s.pkey) AS BIGINT) AS TEXT)) AS product_name,
       MAX(s.total_cost) AS total_cost,
       MAX(i.avg_on_hand_value) AS avg_on_hand_value,
       MAX(i.snapshot_days) AS snapshot_days,
       MAX(s.total_cost) / NULLIF(MAX(i.avg_on_hand_value), 0) AS inventory_turnover
FROM s LEFT JOIN inv_avg i ON s.pkey = i.pkey2
GROUP BY s.pkey
ORDER BY inventory_turnover DESC

),

  SELECT employee."EmployeeKey" AS manager_key,

         MIN(employee."LastName") AS mgr_last
  FROM employee
  GROUP BY employee."EmployeeKey"
)

       emp.emp_first || ' ' || emp.emp_last AS employee_name,
       mgr.mgr_first || ' ' || mgr.mgr_last AS manager_name
FROM emp
LEFT JOIN mgr ON emp.mgr_key = mgr.manager_key
ORDER BY emp.emp_key
LIMIT 5

    store.StoreName AS store_name,
    product.ProductName AS product_name,
    sales.ProductKey AS product_key,
    MEASURE(sales.sales_amount) AS amt
  FROM store
  CROSS JOIN (product CROSS JOIN (sales CROSS JOIN calendar))
  WHERE calendar.CalendarYear = 2009
  GROUP BY store.StoreName, product.ProductName, sales.ProductKey
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT store_name, product_key, product_name, amt,
    CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_name ORDER BY amt DESC) AS BIGINT) AS rn,
    SUM(amt) OVER (PARTITION BY store_name) AS store_total
  FROM sp
)
SELECT store_name, rn AS rank_no,
  COALESCE(product_name, CAST(product_key AS TEXT)) AS product,
  product_key,
  amt AS sales_amount,
  store_total,
  ROUND(100 * amt / NULLIF(store_total, 0), 2) AS share_pct
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY store_name, rank_no

WITH prod_inv AS (
  SELECT inventory.ProductKey AS ProductKey,
         MEASURE(inventory.current_on_hand_quantity) AS on_hand_qty,
         MEASURE(inventory.current_safety_stock_quantity) AS safety_stock_qty
  FROM inventory
  GROUP BY inventory.ProductKey
),
prod_totals AS (
  SELECT ProductKey,
         on_hand_qty,
         safety_stock_qty,
         on_hand_qty - safety_stock_qty AS gap
  FROM prod_inv
),
top_products AS (
  SELECT ProductKey,
         on_hand_qty,
         safety_stock_qty,
         gap,
         CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY gap DESC) AS BIGINT) AS rank
  FROM prod_totals
  ORDER BY gap DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
prod AS (
  SELECT product.ProductKey AS ProductKey,
         product.ProductName AS ProductName
  FROM product
  GROUP BY product.ProductKey, product.ProductName
)
SELECT tp.rank AS rank,
       COALESCE(p.ProductName, CAST(tp.ProductKey AS TEXT)) AS product_name,
       tp.ProductKey AS product_key,
       tp.on_hand_qty AS on_hand_qty,
       tp.safety_stock_qty AS safety_stock_qty,
       tp.gap AS gap
FROM top_products tp
LEFT JOIN prod p ON tp.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
ORDER BY tp.rank
turns.assumption: “差额”指按产品汇总的当前在手库存数量减安全库存数量，且当前库存按每个门店×产品各自最近一次快照计算。

WITH inv_snap AS (
  SELECT inventory.DateKey AS DateKey,
         inventory.StoreKey AS StoreKey,
         inventory.ProductKey AS ProductKey,
         MEASURE(inventory.snapshot_on_hand_quantity) AS on_hand,
         MEASURE(inventory.snapshot_safety_stock_quantity) AS safety_stock
  FROM inventory
  GROUP BY inventory.DateKey, inventory.StoreKey, inventory.ProductKey
),
inv_ranked AS (
  SELECT DateKey, StoreKey, ProductKey, on_hand, safety_stock,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY StoreKey, ProductKey ORDER BY DateKey DESC) AS rn
  FROM inv_snap
),
inv_latest AS (
  SELECT StoreKey, ProductKey, on_hand, safety_stock
  FROM inv_ranked
  WHERE rn = 1
),
prod_totals AS (
  SELECT ProductKey,
         SUM(on_hand) AS on_hand_qty,
         SUM(safety_stock) AS safety_stock_qty,
         SUM(on_hand) - SUM(safety_stock) AS gap
  FROM inv_latest
  GROUP BY ProductKey
),
top_products AS (
  SELECT ProductKey, on_hand_qty, safety_stock_qty, gap,
         CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SUM(on_hand) - SUM(safety_stock)) DESC) AS BIGINT) AS rank
  FROM inv_latest
  GROUP BY ProductKey
  ORDER BY gap DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
prod AS (
  SELECT product.ProductKey AS ProductKey, product.ProductName AS ProductName
  FROM product
  GROUP BY product.ProductKey, product.ProductName
)
SELECT tp.rank AS rank,
       COALESCE(p.ProductName, CAST(tp.ProductKey AS TEXT)) AS product_name,
       tp.ProductKey AS product_key,
       tp.on_hand_qty AS on_hand_qty,
       tp.safety_stock_qty AS safety_stock_qty,
       tp.gap AS gap
FROM top_products tp
LEFT JOIN prod p ON tp.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
